name: PurpleSharp Active Directory Playbook I – Password Spraying, Kerberoasting, Share Discovery, and WinRM Lateral Movement
root_cause: User 'THESHIRE\pgustavo' on WORKSTATION5.theshire.local (172.18.39.5) executed C:\Users\pgustavo\Downloads\PurpleSharp.exe (PID 7520, spawned by cmd.exe) with arguments '/t T1110.003,T1558.003,T1135,T1021.006'. PurpleSharp performed four Active Directory attack techniques: (1) Password spraying (T1110.003) causing 7 failed logons (EventID 4625, status 0xc000006d) on WORKSTATION5 against lrodriguez, pgustavo, sysmonsvc, sbeavers, mscott, pbeesly, and nxlogsvc; (2) Kerberoasting (T1558.003) requesting RC4-HMAC (0x17) Kerberos TGS tickets (EventID 4769) on MORDORDC.theshire.local for SPNs sysmonsvc, nxlogsvc, defensesvc, otrsvc, and mordorsvc; (3) Network share discovery (T1135) over SMB port 445 (\\*\IPC$, EventID 5140/5145) against MORDORDC.theshire.local (172.18.38.5), WORKSTATION6.theshire.local (172.18.39.6), and WORKSTATION7.theshire.local (172.18.39.7); and (4) WinRM lateral movement (T1021.006) over TCP port 5985 to MORDORDC, WORKSTATION6, and WORKSTATION7, spawning wsmprovhost.exe and powershell.exe under THESHIRE\pgustavo.
remediation_actions: Isolate WORKSTATION5.theshire.local (172.18.39.5) from the network and terminate any active PurpleSharp.exe or unauthorized WinRM/PowerShell sessions.
Quarantine and remove C:\Users\pgustavo\Downloads\PurpleSharp.exe and block its SHA-256/MD5 hashes in endpoint detection policies.
Reset credentials and revoke active Kerberos/NTLM sessions for THESHIRE\pgustavo, and audit the sprayed accounts (lrodriguez, sbeavers, mscott, pbeesly) for unauthorized access.
Rotate passwords for the Kerberoasted service accounts (sysmonsvc, nxlogsvc, defensesvc, otrsvc, mordorsvc) and enforce AES encryption (disable RC4-HMAC 0x17) for Kerberos TGS tickets.

Audit WinRM (port 5985) and SMB (port 445) activity on MORDORDC.theshire.local, WORKSTATION6.theshire.local, and WORKSTATION7.theshire.local, and restrict WinRM access to authorized administrative hosts.
Add SIEM detection rules for EventID 4769 with TicketEncryptionType 0x17, bursts of EventID 4625 across multiple accounts, and wsmprovhost.exe spawning powershell.exe.
